title: How a Godly Man Turns the Guys He Lifts With Into Actual Brothers
caption:
You could tell me his bench max before you could tell me what he's actually carrying this week. That's not friendship. That's a rep count with a name attached.

"You good?" gets a nod and a fist bump. Try asking what's actually going on once, after the last set, before anyone reaches for their phone. Iron doesn't sharpen iron from across the gym.

Stay past the last set. Tell him about the morning you didn't want to show up, not just the one you crushed. That's what turns a training partner into a brother.

#faith #brotherhood #godlyman #christianmen #community
